title: 限定词与数量词
explanation:
## 限定词与数量词:名词前的"限定"艺术

限定词(determiner)用来限定名词的范围,数量词表达"多少"。二者决定名词前能不能加 a/an、用不用复数。

## 三类基本限定词

1. **冠词**:a/an(一个), the(特指)。
2. **物主/指示**:my, your, his... this, that, these, those。
3. **数量词**:some, any, many, much, few, little, several, enough。

## 可数 vs 不可数

- many + 可数复数 / much + 不可数:I have many books, but not much time。
- a few(几个,肯定)/ few(几乎没有,否定)+ 可数;a little(一点)/ little(几乎没有)+ 不可数。
- some 用于肯定句和邀请请求;any 用于否定和疑问。

## 数量结构

- 大量:a lot of / lots of / plenty of(可数不可数皆可);a large number of + 可数;a large amount of + 不可数。
- 少量:a bit of + 不可数;a couple of + 可数。

## 语序问题

限定词之间也有顺序:both my parents;all the students;half an hour。易错点:such a beautiful day(a 在 such 后),so beautiful a day(so 后)。

examples.en: There is little water in the bottle.
examples.note: little + 不可数 water,含否定意味"几乎没有"。

examples.en: A few students have passed the test.
examples.cn: 有几个学生通过了考试。
examples.note: a few + 可数复数,肯定意味"有几个"。

examples.en: I have plenty of time to prepare.
examples.note: plenty of 可修饰可数与不可数名词。

examples.en: Such an interesting story deserves sharing.
examples.cn: 这么有趣的故事值得分享。
examples.note: such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词的固定语序。

errors.wrong: There are a little books on the shelf.
errors.right: There are a few books on the shelf.
errors.note: books 可数复数,用 a few。

errors.wrong: He asked me some questions, but I couldn't answer any of them. (改为否定语气)
errors.right: He asked me some questions, and I answered a few of them.
errors.note: a few 表肯定"几个",few 表否定"几乎没几个"。

quiz.q: ___ of the students have passed the exam.
quiz.note: students 可数复数,用 a few。

quiz.q: I have ___ time left; I can't help you.
quiz.note: time 不可数 + 否定意味,用 little。
疑问句中表示邀请/请求时用 some。

quiz.q: It was ___ wonderful day that we stayed out all day.
quiz.note: such a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + that。
